sources.publisher: Southern Poverty Law Center
sources.title: Methodology: How hate groups are identified and categorized
supports: SPLC defines and classifies hate groups using its own stated methodology
SPLC distinguishes organizations from individuals
historical methodology relied on publications, citizen reports, law enforcement, field sources, web postings and news reports
classification should be modeled as classifier -> classification event -> entity, not intrinsic universal truth
